successCriteria.note: Six transparent atlases, 36 frames, and documented per-frame anchors, rates, looping, facing, and render scale are committed.
The real PlanGraph companion walks, runs, jumps, and climbs current ticket cards; pan, zoom, resize, model changes, and dragging were exercised.
Pause, reduced-motion static rendering, visibility stopping, and cleanup are tested; the decorative layer ignores pointer input.
The full project gate and inspected production preview passed; evidence is in docs/verification/DM-125-acceptance.md.

outcome.summary: The requested sprites and in-app mascot behavior are implemented and verified on the epic branch.

provenance.note: Extends the completed mascot branding work with sprite animation and board behavior.
